subject.title: Complementary tool: automated skill quality scoring for curation workflow

question: Should ClawHub endorse or integrate agent-skill-infra-style model-backed quality scoring and eval/version-drift outputs into the curation workflow, and if so what trust boundary should those outputs have?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow source bug: maintainers need to decide external tool endorsement, model-provider data handling, output provenance, and whether quality signals may influence review, visibility, or only advisory triage.

options.title: Define advisory contract first
options.body: Specify provider/data-handling rules, output provenance, freshness, storage shape, and advisory-only semantics before documenting or integrating the tool.

options.title: Document as optional external tool
options.body: Mention agent-skill-infra as a community reviewer aid without ingesting its output or implying ClawHub endorsement.

options.title: Fold into broader trust-signal RFC
options.body: Route this proposal into the broader quality/content-policy discussions and defer implementation until those definitions are settled.

recommendation.title: Define advisory contract first
recommendation.body: Specify provider/data-handling rules, output provenance, freshness, storage shape, and advisory-only semantics before documenting or integrating the tool.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the CODEOWNERS-listed reviewer on the relevant backend, publish, schema, CLI, moderation, and security-doc paths and authored adjacent validation/security work.
